name: raizen-hub
description: Settle an app of any kind one layer at a time, whether the layer is empty or already running: app-settle for the domain, stack and the docs/ documents; logic-settle for the layer between database and UI; design-settle for the visual direction and DESIGN.md. Each audits what exists first, so one skill covers bootstrap, documentation and rework alike. app-align is the one that changes existing code, bringing a repo that predates these rules or drifted from them back onto them.
